title: Even 200 Million Chess.com Accounts Cover Just A Third
hook: Chess.com reached 200 million accounts, yet covers only a third.
closing: Online chess exploded, but most regular players still exist beyond one platform.
question: Where do you play chess?

segments.say: Chess.com reached 200 million accounts, turning a niche website into a massive global platform.
Monthly signups reached 2.8 million after The Queen's Gambit, nearly tripling the baseline.
The world has 605 million regular players, so even the largest platform covers only about a third.
